PatchTargetCorrectionResult CorrectPath(
    string requestedPath,
    IReadOnlyList<LocalCoderFileContext> selectedContexts)

- If requestedPath exists in selectedContexts, return IsCorrected=false.
- Otherwise infer symbol name from filename.
- Search selected context contents for:
  class SymbolName
  record SymbolName
  interface SymbolName
- If found, return corrected path and reason.
- Otherwise return IsCorrected=false.
